templates./etc/systemd/system/k3s.service.d/30-sug:
# Managed by ethernet_quorum_recover.py
[Service]
ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/timeout 180s /usr/bin/python3 -I /usr/local/libexec/sugarkube/ethernet-quorum-recover.py pre-start --enrollment /etc/rancher/k3s/sugarkube-recovery.json
ExecStartPost=-/usr/bin/timeout 60s /usr/bin/python3 -I /usr/local/libexec/sugarkube/ethernet-quorum-recover.py post-start --enrollment /etc/rancher/k3s/sugarkube-recovery.json
templates./etc/systemd/system/sugarkube-ethernet-d:
# Managed by ethernet_quorum_recover.py
[Unit]
Description=Enrolled Ethernet mDNS resolver for K3s
After=network-online.target
Before=k3s.service
StartLimitIntervalSec=300
StartLimitBurst=3
[Service]
Type=notify
NotifyAccess=main
User=root
UMask=0022
RuntimeDirectory=sugarkube-ethernet-dns
RuntimeDirectoryMode=0755
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -I /usr/local/libexec/sugarkube/ethernet_mdns_resolver.py --enrollment /etc/rancher/k3s/sugarkube-dns.json
TimeoutStartSec=15
TimeoutStopSec=5
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10
templates./etc/systemd/system/sugarkube-ethernet-r:
# Managed by ethernet_quorum_recover.py
[Unit]
Description=Guarded Ethernet address recovery
After=network-online.target
[Service]
Type=oneshot
User=root
UMask=0077
TimeoutStartSec=185
ExecStart=/usr/bin/timeout 180s /usr/bin/python3 -I /usr/local/libexec/sugarkube/ethernet-quorum-recover.py watch --enrollment /etc/rancher/k3s/sugarkube-recovery.json

# Managed by ethernet_quorum_recover.py
[Unit]
Description=Observe Ethernet address changes
[Timer]
OnBootSec=60s
OnUnitInactiveSec=30s
AccuracySec=5s
Unit=sugarkube-ethernet-recovery.service
[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
